{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Capital}}
[[File:Capital_size_chart.png|thumb|right|250px|Size comparison of various capital ships]]
{{Quote|Capital starships serve many functions: exploration, transportation, tourism, and &ndash; especially in recent times &ndash; war.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Elpfel]], commanding officer of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Wavesong]]''|<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
A '''capital ship''' was any armed military [[Starship/Legends|starship]] over one hundred meters long. Ships of this class ranged from small and nimble [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] like the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] to titanic [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]], such as the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']].

==History==
{{Quote|But these instruments of destruction have their weaknesses as well. High power consumption, low maneuverability; complex redundant system design, large crew requirements, tactical disadvantages against small starfighters - luckily for the galaxy, these ships are not unstoppable, though they come closer than any other weapon in recorded history&hellip;|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Elpfel]]|<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition" />}}
[[File:Venator-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers were the primary capital ship of the Republic during the Clone Wars]]
Ships of this class were typically designed for [[Space warfare/Legends|fleet warfare]], often positioned in armadas stationed in high orbit around a strategic planet. They formed the primary attack groups in most fleets. There were, however, exceptions to the typical definition. For example, the [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]] was considered a capital ship because of its heavy armament, despite being a mere twenty-five meters in length and operating primarily in the role of a heavy assault [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

These vessels were commonly fitted with ship-to-ship and anti-fighter defensive weaponry, ranging from heavy [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] to [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets. Many capital-ship classes also served as [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]] and were able to deploy starfighters, [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]], and other resources as required.

Given their size, capital ships required relatively large crews, employing in some instances thousands of beings. An example was the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], which was 1,600 meters long and required a crew of 37,000 to operate at full efficiency. There were also examples that utilized substantially fewer active personnel, whether by means of advanced control systems or simple necessity, as in the cases of the [[Katana fleet]] and the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', respectively.

Especially during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], capital ships passing through systems uploaded new data, such as new laws, appointments, wanted criminals or records of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. Thus the local networks were kept up to date all across the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed novelization">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

==Classification==
The [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]] divided capital ships into seven main classifications.

*[[Corvette/Legends|Corvettes]]: Ships roughly 100&ndash;200 meters long<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
**[[CR70 corvette/Legends|CR70 corvette]]<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]<ref name="Stele">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref>
**[[Vigil-class corvette|''Vigil''-class corvette]]
*[[Frigate/Legends|Frigates]]: Ships roughly 200&ndash;400 meters long<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]]<ref name="Imp">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
**[[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]]<ref name="TIE">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>
*[[Cruiser/Legends|Cruisers]]: Ships roughly 400&ndash;600 meters long<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]]<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[Heavy cruiser/Legends|Heavy cruisers]]: Ships roughly 600&ndash;1000 meters long<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="TIE" />
*[[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]: Ships roughly 1000&ndash;2000 meters long<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Cross">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
**[[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[Battlecruiser/Legends|Battlecruisers]]: Ships roughly 2000&ndash;5000 meters long<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Bulwark Mark III]]<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
**[[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|''Praetor II''-class Star Battlecruiser]]<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnaughts]]: All ships over 5000 meters long<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]]<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class dreadnought]]<ref name="Starships">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

A ship's classification could also depend on its armament and intended role. For example, the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser's]] length of 350 meters would classify it as a frigate, but its armament and role sometimes caused it to be classified as a cruiser.<ref name="Warfare" />
